# Youyou Cookies | MADE WITH LOVE

> Youyou Cookies is a 100% online specialty bakery based in Settat, Morocco. Founded and run by Aya, we specialize in handcrafted, small-batch thick cookies baked fresh daily with premium ingredients. We offer free local delivery within Settat.

## Youyou Cookies Pages

- [Home](https://youyouscookies.vercel.app/)
- [Menu](https://youyouscookies.vercel.app/menu.html)
- [Reviews & Notes](https://youyouscookies.vercel.app/reviews.html)
- [Contact Us & Shipping](https://youyouscookies.vercel.app/contact.html)

## Store & Order Information

- **Location:** 100% Online Bakery (Based in Settat, Morocco)
- **Baking & Support Hours:** Wednesday to Sunday, 11:00 – 19:00 (Closed Monday & Tuesday)
- **Delivery Hours:** Daily, 15:00 – 20:00 
- **Contact:** youyouscookies@gmail.com
- **Instagram:** @youyou_s_cookies
- **Order Rules:** No minimum order requirement. We exclusively accept Cash on Delivery (COD). Free direct delivery anywhere in Settat.

## Menu Highlights (Prices subject to change based on in-store updates)

- Classic Cookies: 7 DH
- Extra Chocolate Cookie: 10 DH
- Oreo Cookie: 12 DH
- Red Velvet Cookie: 12 DH
- Kinder Cookie: 13 DH
- Lotus Cookie: 15 DH
- Mini Cookies Box (10 pieces): 15 DH
- Mini Cookies Box (15 pieces - Best Choice): 20 DH
- Mini Cookies Box (20 pieces): 27 DH
- Mini Cookies Box (30 pieces): 40 DH
- Mix & Match Flavours Available
- Chocolate Sauce Extras (Milk or Dark Chocolate) Available

## Notes
Seasonal flavors rotate monthly. All cookies are baked in small batches daily and heat-sealed for maximum freshness during transit. Check our Instagram for the daily #CookieOfTheDay and live updates.
